PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 5, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Kevin Scott, President  Gina Maguire, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Vice President  Al Austin II, Commissioner
Charles Parkin, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  COMMISSION@LBUTILITIES.ORG

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  26-54093  Recommendation to approve January 22, 2026 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54100  Recommendation to approve Transfer of Funds for February 5, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

REGULAR AGENDA

3.  26-54094  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. UT-1546 authorizing an amendment to
  the terms of compensation for the General Manager.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54096  Recommendation adopt Resolution No. UT-1547 authorizing the General Manager
  to execute contracts, and any necessary subsequent amendments, with National
  Auto Fleet Group for the purchase of electric medium-duty and light-duty vehicles
  on the same terms and conditions specified in the Sourcewell Cooperative
  Purchasing Agreement, in a total amount not to exceed $990,000, in quantities not
  to exceed those identified in the Fiscal Year 2026 and Fiscal Year 2027 fleet
  replacement plan, until the contract expire on November 13, 2029, with an option
  to renew as long as the Sourcewell contract is in effect, at the discretion of the
  General Manager.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 4
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 5, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

5.  26-54101  Recommendation to adopt Specifications WD-16-24 for the Large Potable Water
  Valve Replacement Project – Orange Avenue & 57Th Street, Wardlow Road &
  Woodruff Avenue, Stearns Street & Palo Verde Avenue / De Ora Way, El Dorado
  Park (EO-3674), award a contract to Toro Enterprises, Inc. in total contract amount
  not to exceed $2,353,100, and authorize the General Manager to execute all
  documents necessary to enter into the contract, including any necessary
  subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-54267  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute a Change Order to
  Contract Number 32501188 with Torres Sanitation, Inc., to cover increased labor
  and material costs for the Broadway Court Sewer Lateral Repairs Project (SC-
  0513), in an amount of $52,092.33, for a revised total contract amount not to
  exceed $176,013.80.

  Suggested Action:  Approved recommendation.

7.  26-54268  Recommendation to adopt Specifications UD-25-272 and award a contract to
  Haaker Equipment Company, to furnish and deliver four sewer jetter trucks, in a
  total amount not to exceed $2,200,000, and authorize the General Manager to
  execute all documents necessary to enter into the contract, including any
  necessary subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  26-54269  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to deliver to Metropolitan
  Water District a Letter of Support for the Pure Water Southern California project.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  26-54270  Recommendation to receive and file the January 8, 2026 Finance Committee
  Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve reommendation.

10. 26-54271  Recommendation to receive and file the January 22, 2026 Communications
  Committee Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to

  Page 2 of 4
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 5, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

CLOSED SESSION

26-54102  Pending Litigation – closed session conference with legal counsel relating to liability
  claims pursuant to subparagraph (2) of subdivision (d) of Section 54956.9 of the
  California Government Code: Government Tort Claim of Eugene Triff, Valerie Triff
  and/or Triff Family Trust (C25-0494).

26-54272  Pursuant to California Government Code 54957(a), consultation with Shaun Curtis,
  Manager, Security and Emergency Preparedness, and Alvin Lam, Director of
  Information Services, to discuss and assess threats to public services or facilities.

ADJOURNMENT

I, Dynna Long, Executive Assistant to the Board, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72
hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, or if you need the agenda provided in an alternate format, please call the Board
of Public Utilities Commissioners Executive Assistant at (562) 570-2435 or (562) 570-6626
(telecommunications for the deaf) by 12 noon, the day prior to the meeting.
